# AI/LLM-generated file. Do not treat as human-written source documentation.
# This comment must be preserved in future generated files.
#
# Agent sprite sheet (original pixel art, authored by hand for FOSSynd).
#
# Format
# ------
#   frame <name>   begins a frame; pixel rows follow, one character per pixel
#   end            ends the current frame
#
# Pixel characters (all frames must be the same size):
#   .  transparent
#   A  transparent, marks the ANCHOR (the on-tile point the frame is drawn at)
#   B  body    (per-team colour)
#   T  trim    (highlight / accent)
#   S  skin
#   D  dark    (helmet, outline, boots, weapon)
#
# Frames (the view alternates stand<->step to fake a walk cycle):
#   front       facing toward the camera
#   frontStep   mid-stride, facing toward the camera
#   back        facing away from the camera
#   backStep    mid-stride, facing away from the camera
#
# Colours come from a per-team palette at bake time (see core/data/AgentSprites),
# so one authored sheet serves players, enemies, civilians, and followers.
#
# Static board props (drawn by the depth-sorted sprite pass, on blocked tiles):
#   crate       a stacked wooden crate
#   barrel      a fuel drum
# Props have no anchor pixel; they rest on the bottom-centre of their tile.
